scope: Theoretical center-support refinement and exact necessary braid-spectrum, based-module and finite modular representation checks; both categorification questions remain unresolved.

cases.public_summary: The rank-26 centralizer candidate passes the expanded six-fixed-label test: an explicit anti-invariant representation reconstructs a rank-22 integer based module. All 226 larger local braid blocks also pass necessary reflection-partition tests. These witnesses construct neither a module category nor a categorification. No original involution was omitted by the earlier fixed-label guard; the case remains unresolved.
structural_obstructions: No nontrivial Tannakian fusion subcategory in the center.
No Morita representative is a nontrivial faithful finite-group extension or equivariantization.
Every tensor functor to a complex fusion category is fully faithful; every dominant tensor quotient is an equivalence, without an assumed pivotal compatibility.

cases.public_summary: In the positive Galois representative, the twist-one center simples are exactly the six constituents of I(1), giving a shorter tensor-functor-rigidity proof. A rank-37 integer witness satisfies all 1,536 equations of the strengthened finite modular representation system, including torus and compressed-S constraints. These are necessary conditions; no categorification or general exclusion is established.

research_summary: Both rank-six cases remain unresolved. For R6_8_1660, the twist-one center simples are exactly the six constituents of I(1), giving a shorter tensor-functor-rigidity proof. An exact rank-37 integer witness passes all 1,536 equations of the strengthened finite modular representation system, including torus and compressed-S constraints. For R6_4_155, all 226 larger local braid blocks pass the strengthened reflection-partition conditions. Its rank-26 centralizer also admits a six-dimensional anti-invariant representation reconstructing a rank-22 integer based module. These are passing necessary tests, not modular-data, module-category or categorification constructions. No original rank-six involution was missed by the earlier two-fixed-label guard.
